tldr.en: Having kids requires a change in mindset. Drop preconceived notions; own the choice to have children and don't complain, since you would be complaining about yourself. Life with kids is different forever, tough and exhausting, an emotional roller coaster whose downs hurt more and whose ups delight more than expected. Kids are your mirror: asking them to improve is asking yourself to improve. Give without expecting return, don't compare or project, believe you and your kids are awesome but not perfect, and enjoy the ride.
tldr.hans: 有了孩子，需要改变心态。抛开先入为主的观念，为自己要孩子的决定负责，不要抱怨，因为那等于抱怨自己。有了孩子，生活永远不同：艰难、疲惫，像坐情感过山车，低谷比想象中更痛，高峰也比想象中更欢乐。孩子是你的镜子，要求孩子进步，就是要求自己进步。不求回报地给予陪伴与关注，不攀比、不把自己的抱负投射到孩子身上；相信孩子和自己都很棒，但不完美。既然买了票，就好好享受这段旅程。
